title: Harness dialectic-guard: Opus needs cheap groundwork first
desc: Blocks an Opus dispatch until thesis/antithesis groundwork exists: 2+ Haiku and 1+ Sonnet cheap-model calls completed this session, so Opus synthesizes rather than thinks one-sided.
steps: TRIGGER: fires on an Opus delegation when the session JSONL lacks 2 completed Haiku (or codex-mini) calls plus 1 Sonnet/GPT/Gemini call as prior evidence.
FIX: run the groundwork via Agent.cmd -- e.g. Agent.cmd --model haiku 'argue FOR'; Agent.cmd --model haiku 'argue AGAINST risks'; Agent.cmd --model sonnet 'synthesize'. Then dispatch Opus.
WHY: one-sided Opus delegation is wasteful; cheap dialectic builds the evidence Opus refines. See: opus-dialectic-gate, agent-cmd.
author: claude
